name: Kettlebell Double Jerk
steps: Clean two kettlebells into the front rack position with your feet hip-width apart, elbows tucked against your torso, and wrists straight.
Dip by bending your knees with your torso upright, then drive through your feet to send the bells upward.
As the kettlebells travel upward, quickly drop under them into a second quarter-squat dip while locking both arms completely straight overhead.
Stand tall to finish the lift, then lower both bells smoothly back into the front rack position while absorbing the weight with soft knees.
tips: Keep your heels flat during the initial dip and drive straight vertically rather than pitching forward.
Catch the bells with locked elbows and packed shoulders before standing up.
